bf-core-celebrated-mothers-day.title: BF CORE Celebrated Mother's Day
bf-core-celebrated-mothers-day.content:
BF CORE Celebrated Mother's Day

» BF CORE Celebrated Mother's Day

In a heartwarming celebration of Mother's Day, BF CORE extended a generous gesture to the community. Throughout the entire month of March 2023, people received a special 21% discount on any residential or deep cleaning services. This exclusive offer not only honored mothers on their special day, celebrated on the 21st of March, but also reflected BF CORE's commitment to fostering a clean and nurturing environment for families. It's a thoughtful way to express gratitude to mothers while ensuring homes are treated with the care they deserve.

bf-core-cleaning-beirut-standing-tall-to.title: BF CORE: Cleaning Beirut, Standing Tall Together
bf-core-cleaning-beirut-standing-tall-to.content:
BF CORE: Cleaning Beirut, Standing Tall Together

» BF CORE: Cleaning Beirut, Standing Tall Together

In a powerful display of community solidarity, BF CORE employees played a pivotal role in revitalizing Beirut's streets post the 2019 revolution. Shoulder to shoulder with local residents, BF Core team undertook a dedicated effort to clean Beirut streets by picking up discarded bottles, cigarette butts, and other trash left by the protestors. Their commitment echoed a shared vision: "We will make this happen... together we will stand tall!" BF Core proved that positive change is achievable when a community unites towards a common cause.

bluefield-agriculture-iraq-introduced-it.title: BlueField Agriculture Iraq Introduced its New Tomato Variety “Oustoura”
bluefield-agriculture-iraq-introduced-it.content:
BlueField Agriculture Iraq Introduced its New Tomato Variety “Oustoura”

» BlueField Agriculture Iraq Introduced its New Tomato Variety “Oustoura”

BlueField Agriculture Iraq hosted a crop demonstration day for farmers covering soil health, sustainable practices, and the latest agricultural advancements. The primary focus of the event was to present to local farmers the remarkable features and benefits of Tomato Oustoura, a new seed variety. Tomato Oustoura is set to transform the local farming landscape with its exceptional attributes, such as resilience, adaptability, and its high yield potential. BlueField Agriculture Iraq continuously empower local farmers with the tools they need to thrive in a dynamic and ever-changing agricultural landscape.

bluefield-agriculture-iraqs-potato-event.title: BlueField Agriculture Iraq's Potato Event in Erbil
bluefield-agriculture-iraqs-potato-event.content:
BlueField Agriculture Iraq's Potato Event in Erbil

» BlueField Agriculture Iraq's Potato Event in Erbil

BlueField Agriculture Iraq hosted an exciting and informative event in the heart of Erbil, at Erbil Rotana Hotel to introduce the new potato variety - Maverick. During the event, attendees had the chance to not only closely inspect the size and appearance of these potatoes, but also to taste these potatoes. BlueField Agriculture Iraq also provided valuable insights about the development of Maverick potatoes. Attendees were educated on the rigorous farming process and quality control measures, showcasing high quality and taste of these potatoes.

bluefield-agriculture-lebanon-demonstrat.content:
BlueField Agriculture Lebanon Demonstrated High-Yield Potato Variety

» BlueField Agriculture Lebanon Demonstrated High-Yield Potato Variety

BlueField Agriculture Lebanon organized a potato field day that brought together farmers, agricultural experts, and potato enthusiasts to explore the possibilities of potato farming. During this Potato field day, a group of farmers and agricultural experts explored the impressive yields of a new and innovative potato variety called Nectar and gained insights into the best practices for growing and farming this type of potato. BlueField Agriculture Lebanon seeks to support farmers and enhance agricultural productivity by helping farmers choose the best practices in potato cultivation, pest and disease management, and sustainable farming methods.

bluefield-group-a-new-identity-for-growt.title: BlueField Group: A New Identity for Growth, Innovation, and Sustainability
bluefield-group-a-new-identity-for-growt.content:
BlueField Group: A New Identity for Growth, Innovation, and Sustainability

» BlueField Group: A New Identity for Growth, Innovation, and Sustainability

In an occasion that implies the beginning of a new era in agricultural innovation, BlueField Group unveiled its revamped identity with a grand re-branding event in Iraq. Emerging from modest beginnings in Iraq with a one product and an unwavering vision for agricultural advancement, the company has grown into a symbol of prosperity and progress. With a dedication deeply rooted in environmental sustainability and social responsibility, BlueField Group has not only cultivated prosperity but also nurtured communities, leading the way in revolutionizing the agricultural sector. BlueField Group's transformation reflects its commitment to growth, innovation, and sustainability. With this bold step forward, BlueField Group invites stakeholders, partners, and clients alike to embark on this dynamic journey of evolution, where the promise of prosperity meets the embrace of sustainability, steering in a new era of agricultural excellence. bluefield-iraq-showcases-modern-agricult.title: BlueField Iraq Showcases Modern Agricultural Solutions at the College of Agriculture’s Exhibition
bluefield-iraq-showcases-modern-agricult.content:
BlueField Iraq Showcases Modern Agricultural Solutions at the College of Agriculture’s Exhibition

» BlueField Iraq Showcases Modern Agricultural Solutions at the College of Agriculture’s Exhibition

BlueField Agriculture Iraq proudly participated on the 10th of March 2022 at the exhibition hosted by the College of Agriculture in Samarra, marking a significant collaboration aimed at advancing the agricultural sector. BlueField Agriculture Iraq highlighted its pivotal role in introducing innovative pest and disease control management programs. BlueField Agriculture Iraq took the opportunity to underscore its commitment to the modernization of agricultural practices. The showcased programs not only demonstrated the efficacy of BlueField Agriculture Iraq’s pest and disease control solutions but also emphasized its dedication to supporting the overall development of the agricultural sector. A remarkable aspect of BlueField’s participation was the spotlight on fertilizer programs, showcasing a comprehensive range from both the governmental side, represented by the Ministry of Agriculture, and the private sector. This initiative aligns with BlueField Group’s vision of fostering collaboration between public and private entities to drive the growth of sustainable agricultural practices.

bluefield-lebanon-showcased-innovation-i.content:
BlueField Lebanon Showcased Innovation in Agriculture

» BlueField Lebanon Showcased Innovation in Agriculture

Committed to agricultural excellence and innovation, BlueField Agriculture Lebanon organized a field day for farmers to showcase them the latest advancements in agriculture and promote a new variety of seeds, particularly the Tomato Zodiac. During this day, attendees had the opportunity to witness advanced agricultural practices and explore the world of sustainable farming. BlueField Lebanon educated farmers and industry professionals about the latest improvements in seed varieties. The highlight of the field day was the introduction of Tomato Zodiac, a seed variety that promises to transform tomato farming. BlueField Agriculture Lebanon is dedicated to supporting farmers, empowering vulnerable communities, and advancing agriculture by constantly innovating and introducing new, cutting-edge products.
